prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1199; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with neck pain, stiffness, and headaches consistent with whiplash-type cervical strain. The mechanism of injury is well matched to the reported symptoms and the force involved in the crash. Cervical range of motion was reduced on examination, with paraspinal tenderness and muscle guarding noted at each visit. Imaging findings clearly confirm the soft-tissue injury, and there is no known prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding structures. Conservative care was provided, including manual therapy, stretching and strengthening exercises, and modalities for pain control. Over eighteen visits the patient improved steadily, though recovery took somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Treatment billing reflects single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. Ongoing home exercise instruction was provided, and the patient was advised to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological signs develop.
